title: Maclaurin Inequalities: Core Definitions for Elementary Symmetric Polynomials
description: Core definitions and standalone theorems for elementary symmetric polynomials and Maclaurin means, independent of Newton's log-concavity (which is in AmgmInequalityOQ02OQ02.lean). Proves: e₀=1, e₁=sum, eₖ≥0, recurrence, extremal cases, M₁²≥M₂ via Cauchy-Schwarz for n=2,3,4, and AM-GM from Mathlib. 12 theorems, 0 axioms.

meta.assumptions: None. All 12 theorems proved with 0 axioms.

overview.historicalContext: Maclaurin (1729) proved M₁ ≥ M₂ ≥ ... ≥ Mₙ for non-negative reals. This file provides the core definitions and special cases.
overview.problemStatement: Define elementary symmetric polynomials and Maclaurin means; prove basic properties and M₁≥M₂.
overview.proofStrategy: elemSymm as sum over powersetCard; maclaurinMean as (eₖ/C(n,k))^{1/k}; M₁≥M₂ via Cauchy-Schwarz.
